---
title: "Testing User Interactivity"
resources:
  - shinylive-sw.js
---

```{shinylive-python}
#| standalone: true

from shiny import ui, render, App

app_ui = ui.page_fluid(
    ui.input_numeric("num", "Enter a number:", value=1),
    ui.output_text("result")
)

def server(input, output, session):
    @output
    @render.text
    def result():
        return f"{input.num()} squared = {input.num() ** 2}"

app = App(app_ui, server)
```
